Create docs, tasks, databases
Search and reference your Notion pages
Create and manage your store

Shopify for ChatGPT makes starting, running, and growing an online store as easy as having a conversation.
Turn a small business idea into an ecommerce website with Shopify’s AI store builder: describe what you sell, create your store, add products, and sell online.
Already have a Shopify store?
Connect it to manage inventory across locations, create discount codes, review orders and customer details, and pull analytics on your store’s performance.
Shopify supports selling online, in person, B2B, on marketplaces, and selling internationally.
Whether you run a print on demand business, sell digital products, operate an online boutique, dropship, or serve wholesale buyers, Shopify gives you the foundation to build, sell, and grow.
Insights to action in HubSpot

Work with your HubSpot data to analyze patterns, create and update records, and manage your CRM operations.
Read from and write to deals, contacts, companies, tickets, engagements, and other objects you have permission to access.
Prepare reports, update deal stages, log calls and emails, create tasks, or review pipeline details before meetings.
Use it for quick updates in chat or comprehensive CRM management, all grounded in your actual HubSpot data.
Learn more: https://knowledge.hubspot.com/integrations/connect-your-hubspot-account-to-chatgpt
Connect 350+ data sources

It pulls performance data from any connected source, and on supported ad and marketing platforms it can make changes directly, such as pausing or enabling a campaign, setting a budget, creating a Google Business Profile post, or replying to a review, always after you confirm.
Analyze global markets

Connect your Interactive Brokers account to ChatGPT and manage your portfolio through natural language.
Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data.
You can also prompt ChatGPT to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval.
ChatGPT never submits orders directly to the market.
Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations.
Member SIPC.
Manage Outlook schedules
Microsoft Outlook calendar for scheduling work: check availability, plan meetings, create events, manage invites.
Manage and query databases

Manage Supabase projects directly through ChatGPT.
Execute SQL queries on PostgreSQL databases, design and modify table schemas, deploy serverless edge functions, and configure user authentication.
Access real-time logs for debugging, create and apply database migrations, and manage development branches through natural language.
Build full-stack apps by chat

Lovable builds and edits full-stack web apps from natural language.
Describe an app and Lovable creates a project, writes the TypeScript, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui code, and returns a live preview you can watch build.
Follow-up messages refine the app, and you can inspect the generated code and diffs, add a PostgreSQL database and third-party connectors, manage reusable project knowledge and skills, and publish the finished app to a public URL.
Manage servers through SSH

Gateway lets users manage owned Linux and Windows OpenSSH servers from ChatGPT: inspect health and configuration, run auditable commands and typed administrative operations, transfer files, and follow durable jobs.
Free website scans and growth

Scan any public web page for 11 SEO fundamentals with a plain-language 'why it matters' and example fix for each issue, get a 10-step website growth framework, or look up how to fix a specific SEO issue
Build interfaces with Lumen

Lumen UI helps coding agents build accessible interfaces from a real multi-framework design-system contract.
Search the component catalog, retrieve framework-specific usage and source, inspect web and native recipes, read semantic tokens, and follow the bundled Lumen workflow for Astro, React, Web Components, React Native, SwiftUI, and Jetpack Compose.
Shop Internet & Wireless

AT&T Products provides an integrated conversational experience that enables users to verify home internet availability, evaluate internet and wireless offerings, explore devices and service plans, locate AT&T stores, manage shopping carts, and transition seamlessly to AT&T checkout.
Customer Support Platform
EasyReply is a customer support platform
Read, send and file your email

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one.
It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file.
Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply.
Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.
Easy accessible links in chat

- "Show me all the links from this chat"
- "Give me 10 links to help me plan a trip to San Francisco"
- "Amazon links for the top 5 sci-fi books of all time"
Build and run AI workflows

Build, test, and deploy automated workflows.
NoClick makes automation accessible — connect your favorite tools, add logic and AI steps, and let your workflows save your time.
Check support ticket fields

Support Ticket Validator checks whether support ticket data contains the required fields before human processing or handoff.
It returns a structured completeness result with checked fields, present fields, missing fields, and validation errors, helping support teams identify incomplete ticket information without modifying external systems.
AWS Data Analytics Plugin

Data lake, analytics, and ETL workflows with S3 Tables, AWS Glue, and Athena.
Covers managed Iceberg tables on S3 Tables, ingestion from JDBC databases, Amazon Redshift, Snowflake, BigQuery, and DynamoDB, AWS Glue Data Catalog inventory and asset discovery, federated Athena queries, and vector storage and semantic search on Amazon S3 Vectors.
Create your own website

Build your entire site and buy a domain right from the chat.
Just ask Wix for the website you want, including all the functionality you need, and get a complete, business-ready site generated for you in minutes.
You can also connect the perfect custom domain to your site and manage everything seamlessly in one place.
If you like, you can continue editing it inside the Wix Harmony editor using tons more AI tools and smooth drag and drop.
Manage contracts from ChatGPT

Simplify contract management with intelligent automation powered by Docusign.
Go beyond simple execution to make complex agreement workflows effortless.
Use natural language to create and send a contract, instantly surface insights like renewal dates and key obligations, and automate workflows that keep your business moving faster and with less friction.
Book clients, get paid

Built for photographers, event planners, venues, designers and consultants.
Requires a HoneyBook account.
Import videos and cut clips

Give Montage a URL or a Google Drive link and it pulls the video in and watches the import until it's done.
From there, ask for a moment.
It cuts the clip and replies with an editor link, so you can trim it or fix the styling before you post it anywhere.
Your agent for creative tasks
Air understands your brand, organizes your library, and scales creative while keeping humans involved where they matter most.
Create 3D Cabinets & Furniture

Create custom cabinets and furniture from a text prompt.
Flatma generates an editable 3D model with real dimensions and panel thicknesses, so you can adjust sizes, shelves, drawers, materials, and other details.
Design wardrobes, kitchen cabinets, desks, tables, shelves, and more.
Open your project on flatma.com for detailed drawings and cut lists.
Analyze and act on hiring data

Ashby in ChatGPT gives you instant access to your pipeline, candidate profiles, open jobs, interviews, and transcripts.
Ask questions, uncover hiring trends, and take action by adding notes, moving stages, or sending emails directly from the chat.
Ashby connects ChatGPT to your live recruiting data through secure user-level OAuth.
Every request and action respects your existing permissions and your data stays protected.
Marketing analytics

Nexoya connects ChatGPT to a Nexoya workspace so marketers can ask natural-language questions about marketing portfolios, campaign or adset contents, funnel steps, labels, events, performance metrics, daily trends, regression-based attribution, and budget optimization recommendations.
The app helps users summarize marketing performance, compare periods and channels, inspect ROI and ROAS, reason about trends, and explain the latest optimization proposal without leaving ChatGPT.
Access is scoped to the signed-in user's Nexoya account and team permissions.
Sourced company dossiers

Company Dossier compiles a complete, source-attributed intelligence file on any company or domain — entirely from public data.
One request returns nine sections: overview & identity, people & org chart, hiring radar, money trail, locations, tech fingerprint, news & timeline, relationship web, and risk flags.
Every claim is tied to a public source and tagged High/Medium/Low confidence.
Built for due diligence, vendor vetting, sales prep, and competitive research.
No accounts, no private data — public sources only.
Business Banking & Invoicing
Finom is a business finance platform for SMEs and freelancers across Europe, combining a business account, invoicing, expense management, and accounting in one place.
Find small business insurance
Get a price estimate for your business insurance.
Real-time crypto market data
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.
Buy products online

Sangria helps users quote supported physical products, review price-locked matches, purchase approved products with an existing Sangria USD credit balance, and check order status.
Profile setup, payment methods, and credit top-ups happen on Sangria's dashboard outside ChatGPT.
Find what's on at UK cinemas
AI-native film and cinema discovery for the UK with verified showtimes and direct booking links.
Track meals, water, exercise

Zinde connects ChatGPT with your Zinde account so you can review daily nutrition, water, steps, exercise, and goal progress in one place.
Ask for a daily or weekly summary, get meal suggestions based on your remaining targets, update your goals, and log meals, water, or exercise after reviewing a preview.
AI workout planning & tracking

Joti is a workout tracking app for planning, scheduling, and logging strength, bodyweight, flexibility, and cardio training.
This connector lets ChatGPT read a user's own workouts, completed workout history, aggregated stats (volume, consistency, personal bests, top lifts), and the shared exercise library (roughly 800 exercises plus the user's own custom ones), and to schedule workouts onto the user's calendar.
Writes are additive only: create a brand-new workout, duplicate an existing one, and fully manage scheduled-workout calendar entries.
It cannot edit or delete an existing workout's exercises/sets, and cannot start, log, or alter a session — those stay in the Joti app.
Body measurements and progress photos are out of scope entirely.
Reads are scoped to data the user owns outright; every write is undoable in Joti's Activity feed.
Build workouts and log sets

FitAI Pro is a workout management app built to help users plan and track gym sessions more efficiently.
It includes a database of over 5,000 exercises with form notes and set/rep guidance, along with tools for logging weights, reps, and sets during workouts.
Users can generate workout plans based on available equipment and monitor their training progress over time.
Personalized meditations, now!
Breethe Meditations Made 4 You: Personalized Guided Meditation
Fantasy football decisions

SAGE helps fantasy football players make weekly and draft decisions using Inner Sanctum rankings and analysis.
Compare players for start/sit and flex decisions, view weekly positional rankings, get lineup recommendations for a linked league, evaluate individual players, and get draft outlooks based on scoring format and roster context.
AI native technographics

Trace gives agents structured data on what technologies companies use, who they partner with, and who they're hiring.
Ask about any company's tech stack, integration ecosystem, or recent hiring signals, and Trace returns structured answers.
Create lists to monitor changes over time.
Useful for account research, market analysis, competitive insights, or spotting when a company adopts a new tool or partner.
Ask questions, run analyses
Answer data questions and spin up new analyses with the Hex Agent.
Map lectures to study routes

MediPrep Study Navigator helps medical students turn lectures and study topics into reviewed, source-safe learning routes.
ChatGPT analyzes learner-provided files and sends MediPrep only short medical concept phrases; MediPrep returns coordinated video metadata, rights-approved shared UWorld question IDs when available, public references, and human-published MediPrep practice.
MediPrep does not receive uploaded files or proprietary question bodies.
Third-party product names are used descriptively; MediPrep is not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.
Primary law research toolkit

Descrybe Legal Engine brings U.S. primary-law research tools into ChatGPT.
Use it to search legal authority, resolve citations, retrieve case details and source passages, check case treatment and citing authorities, and verify quoted legal language.
It helps legal professionals and serious legal researchers move from a question to primary legal sources they can read and verify.
Search Quran, tafsir, hadith
Search and retrieve Quran ayahs, tafsir commentary, hadith search results, and detailed hadith records with Arabic and English text, source headings, grades, and canonical links.
Assess state feasibility

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.
Chemistry & Biology Simulation

Use Rowan in ChatGPT to run and manage computational chemistry and structural biology workflows.
Predict molecular properties, search conformers and reaction paths, and calculate energies, structures, spectra, and electronic properties with quantum chemistry.
Prepare proteins and run structure prediction, docking, molecular dynamics, and binding affinity workflows.
Calculations are saved to Rowan and available in the web app,  while existing Rowan work can be viewed and managed from ChatGPT.
Track jobs, inspect results, and download supported files.
Verify peptide COA evidence

Search and inspect public peptide certificates of analysis using the PeptidePrices evidence library and supported laboratory records.
Look up exact report identifiers or public certificate URLs, review vendor and compound matches, inspect reported testing panels, browse a vendor’s published certificate feed, or compare documented COA coverage across vendors.
Results keep laboratory-record confirmation, vendor attribution, product and labeled-strength matching, reported analytical results, and physical-vial chain of custody separate.
Missing, blocked, unsupported, or unresolved records remain unknown rather than being treated as failures.
Each result includes structured evidence and links to PeptidePrices, certificate documents, and specific official laboratory records when available.
Investigate insider threats

Above brings your identity-security data into ChatGPT.
Ask in plain language to list open incidents and high-risk identities; inspect incident timelines, evidence, and insights; look up devices, monitored applications, and audit logs; and run investigative searches across your tenant.
You can also triage from chat — set incident status, verdict, and resolution notes, or add an identity to the watch list.
Access requires an Above Security account and is scoped to your role and company; read and write are governed by explicit OAuth consent.
Free digital security tools

Bitdefender Plugin has a collection of free tools which help users avoid malware, phishing attempts, and counterfeit websites which includes: 
- Link Checker 
- Phone Number 
- Password Generator
- Digital Footprint Checker
- Product Recommendations
Secure software supply chain

Safeguard helps users inspect software supply chain risk from ChatGPT, including vulnerabilities, SBOMs, findings, projects, components, policies, guardrails, compliance reports, remediation plans, SCM integrations, notifications, and organization workflows.
Book hotels & cruises

TiCATi is a curated luxury travel platform with direct hotel contracts and exclusive guest benefits.
Search thousands of hotels worldwide, get live room availability and pricing instantly in your currency, and explore curated cruise voyages with exclusive onboard credits and VIP amenities.
Ask for a hotel by name and TiCATi returns live rates immediately, no sign-in required.
A personal concierge is available via WhatsApp for bookings, upgrades, and special requests.

管理并查询数据库

通过ChatGPT直接管理Supabase项目。
对PostgreSQL数据库执行SQL查询，设计和修改表结构，部署无服务器边缘函数，并配置用户认证。
访问实时日志进行调试，创建并应用数据库迁移，通过自然语言管理开发分支。

直接通过 ChatGPT 管理 Supabase 项目。
在 PostgreSQL 数据库上执行 SQL 查询、设计与修改表结构、部署无服务器边缘函数并配置用户身份验证。
通过自然语言访问实时日志进行调试、创建并应用数据库迁移，以及管理开发分支。
通过对话构建全栈应用
Lovable通过自然语言构建和编辑全栈网页应用。描述一个应用，Lovable会创建项目，编写TypeScript、Tailwind和shadcn/ui代码，并返回可实时观看构建过程的预览界面。后续对话可进一步优化应用，您可检查生成代码与差异，添加PostgreSQL数据库和第三方连接器，管理可复用的项目知识与技能，并将完成的应用发布到公共URL。
通过聊天构建全栈应用
Lovable 可以通过自然语言构建和编辑全栈网页应用。描述一个应用，Lovable 就会创建项目、编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并返回一个实时预览，让你可以观看构建过程。后续消息可以进一步完善应用，你还可以查看生成的代码和差异，添加 PostgreSQL 数据库和第三方连接器，管理可重用的项目知识和技能，并将完成的应用发布到公共 URL。

Lovable 可以根据自然语言构建和编辑全栈 Web 应用。
只需描述应用需求，Lovable 就会创建项目，编写 TypeScript、Tailwind 和 shadcn/ui 代码，并提供一个可以实时观察构建过程的预览界面。
